title: Cauchy–Schwarz rigidity: the curve is the great-circle arc in span{u, e}
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, orthonormal u, e ∈ ℝ^P, every real s and every γ : ℝ → ℝ^P that is C¹ on (−s, s) with ‖γ(α)‖ = 1, ⟨γ(α), u⟩ > 0, arctan(⟨γ(α),e⟩/⟨γ(α),u⟩) = α and ‖γ′(α)‖ = ⟨γ(α),u⟩² + ⟨γ(α),e⟩² for every α ∈ (−s, s): γ(α) = cos α·u + sin α·e for every α ∈ (−s, s).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u e = 0 → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖deriv γ α‖ = inner ℝ (γ α) u ^ 2 + inner ℝ (γ α) e ^ 2) → ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, γ α = Real.cos α • u + Real.sin α • e
